name: romance-text-3
description: Three marketing paragraphs providing a layered product narrative: what it is, what it does, and who it is for.
system_prompt_additions: Generate exactly 3 distinct marketing paragraphs. Paragraph 1: introduce the product and its headline benefit. Paragraph 2: highlight key technical features or specifications in consumer-friendly language. Paragraph 3: describe the ideal use case or target audience. Each paragraph should be 2-3 sentences. Do not include price, availability, or store-specific references.

output_schema.model_number: string | null — manufacturer part or model number
romance_text_paragraphs: string — paragraph 1: product introduction and headline benefit
string — paragraph 2: key technical features in consumer language
string — paragraph 3: ideal use case and target audience
